entities.name: William M. Tuck
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: William Munford Tuck was an American lawyer and lieutenant in the Byrd Organization, who served as the 55th Governor of Virginia from 1946 to 1950 as a Democrat, and as a U.S. Congressman from 1953 until 1969.
